provenance: Post-run lossless archival; commands originally emitted the uncompressed .json paths. All bytes and original source bindings are preserved.
restoration: After extracting the native evidence bundle, run python3 checks/restore_evidence.py --out /path/to/new-directory from the return root. Omitting --out verifies compressed and original hashes without writing files. Standard python3 -m gzip -d FILE.json.gz also restores each file.
